handlers.name: ActorType4F_PlayerCollisionHandler
handlers.semantics: Within the +/-0x18 actor/player X window and with the interaction-animation gate clear, writes PLAYER_VY=-0x0800, installs PLAYER_ANIM_TRANSITION_FLAG_RESPONSE, arms TERRAIN_RESPONSE_ACTIVE, clears TERRAIN_VERTICAL_STOP, optionally queues event 0x4B, and installs the type-0x84 response animation at 0x00124B3E.

handlers.name: ActorType4E_PlayerCollisionHandler
handlers.semantics: With non-upward motion and the interaction-animation gate clear, writes PLAYER_VX=+0x0700 or -0x0700 from actor facing, PLAYER_VY=-0x0700, installs PLAYER_ANIM_TRANSITION_FLAG_RESPONSE, arms TERRAIN_RESPONSE_ACTIVE, clears TERRAIN_VERTICAL_STOP, installs the type-0x84 response animation at 0x00124B1A, and calls the event/audio helper at 0x001AFD32.

shared_contract.source_actor: converted to type 0x84 and response animation installed

boundary_checks.result: Both direct table bodies end at their RTS immediately before the next helper/entry; no promoted ranges overlap.

reachability_qualification: The existing Level 01 transfer-capable mechanism audit records these as real launch writers but found no live Level 01 producer chain reaching the unresolved upper corridor.
conclusion: The two strongest remaining direct transfer writers are now canonicalized with exact velocity, terrain-response, animation, and source-actor contracts. They are available for static deasm naming and future reachability/parity checks without treating them as proven Level 01 route producers.
